description: Which ads are tired? Compares each ad of a campaign or ad squad this window vs the one before: FATIGUED (ROAS down 30%+ with higher frequency or lower swipe rate), WATCH, HEALTHY, STOPPED, NEW (read-only). end_time must be hour-aligned with an offset; days defaults to 7.

days.description: How many whole days back to look, counted from the start of today in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET.

entity.description: What to act on: campaign, adsquad or ad (ad squads are Snapchat's ad sets).

id.description: Id of the item named by entity. Get it from snap_list_campaigns, snap_list_adsquads or snap_list_ads.

min_spend.description: Ignore items that spent less than this, in account currency (too little data to judge).

name: snap_creative_fatigue
